howto.title: How to Play
howto.standard1: Six mountains 5–10. You have a 🐐 at the foot of each. Heights: 5,6→4; 7,8→3; 9,10→2.
howto.standard2: On your turn, roll 4 dice (multiple 1s: keep one, re-face the rest).
howto.standard3: Group dice — each group whose sum is 5–10 moves that mountain's goat up one space.
howto.standard4: Reach a top to take a Point Token (and bump the goat there off). Already on top? A match harvests another token.
howto.standard5: Collect from all 6 mountains (a set) to claim a Bonus Token ✨ (15/12/9/6).
howto.standard6: End when all Bonus Tokens are gone or 3 mountains empty, then equal turns. Most points wins. 🏆 Winners by table size: 2–4p → 1st, 5–7p → top 2, 8–10p → top 3.
howto.team1: Teams of 2 or 3 players share a combined score. Supported: 4p→2 teams, 6p→2 or 3 teams.
howto.team2: Teammates can share summits — no bumping between teammates.
howto.team3: Each player collects their own tokens, even if a teammate is already on that summit.
howto.team4: If an opposing player reaches a team-held summit, all teammate goats there are bumped back to base (Team Wipeout).
howto.team6: Team with the highest combined score wins. Same tie-break rules apply at team level.

tutorial.introBody: Learn the full Standard rules — starting positions, dice, climbing, bumps, harvest, End Turn, bonuses, and how games end. Tap the glowing controls to continue.
tutorial.bonusInfoBody: Collect a token from all 6 mountains (a full set) to claim a Bonus Token (15 / 12 / 9 / 6).
tutorial.doneBody: You know the Standard rules. Create a room or join friends to play for real. Team mode tips stay under How to Play.

inline.mountainsExplain: Six mountains numbered 5–10. A dice group that sums to that number climbs that mountain. 5–6 are tall (4 spaces); 9–10 are short (2 spaces).
inline.tokens: Each colored circle is the mountain number. The × count is how many point tokens remain — a token is worth that mountain's number when you take the summit.
inline.boardStart: Every goat starts at the foot (bottom) of each mountain. Yours and Rival's are highlighted below.
inline.noticeUsed: Dice you already used this turn are dimmed and cannot be selected again.
inline.firstToken: First summit! You took 1 point token from Mountain 10 — that adds 10 points to your score. The × count on that mountain dropped by 1.
inline.rivalBump: Rival took your summit — you were bumped back to the foot. Only one goat holds a summit in Standard mode.
inline.bonusSetup: Fast-forward: you already have a point token from mountains 5–9. Only mountain 10 is missing from your set. Claim it to earn a Bonus Token.

ones.title: Multiple 1s
ones.body: If you roll more than one 1, keep one 1 and re-face extras to any face (1–6) with ↻. Then play this turn however you like — group dice and climb. When the turn ends, the tutorial continues.

bonusClaimed.title: Bonus claimed!
bonusClaimed.body: You collected a token from all 6 mountains — a full set. That claims the highest Bonus Token (✨15). Later sets claim 12, then 9, then 6.

ending.title: How games end
ending.body: The final round starts when all Bonus Tokens are claimed or 3 mountains run out of point tokens. Everyone gets equal turns, then most points wins. Ties: most goats on tops, then a goat on the higher-numbered mountain.

coach.onesExplain: Learn what happens when you roll multiple 1s.
coach.roll1: Tap Roll Dice to roll your 4 dice.
coach.sel6: Tap the die showing 6. Groups that sum to 5–10 climb that mountain.

coach.summit: Tap Mountain 10 to reach the summit and take a point token.
coach.roll2: You are on the summit. Tap Roll Dice again.
coach.selH4: Tap 4 — a matching group while on top harvests another token.
coach.selH6: Tap 6 to finish the group of 10.
coach.harvest: Tap Mountain 10 to harvest another point token.
coach.autoEndWithBanner: {banner} In a real game this wait auto-ends after 2 seconds.
coach.autoEnd: No groups of 5–10 remain. Tap End Turn.
coach.roll3: Tap Roll Dice — you rolled two 1s.
coach.freeTurn: Your turn — re-face 1s with ↻ if you want, group dice (sum 5–10), and climb. The turn ends when you have used all the dice you can.
coach.rollBonus: Tap Roll Dice — finish the set on mountain 10.
coach.climbBonus: Tap Mountain 10 to take the last token and claim a Bonus!
coach.ending: How a game ends and who wins.
